in_sanskrit.name: वंश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The root 'van' means 'to grow' and 'sh' denotes 'lineage' or 'dynasty'. The name Vamsha signifies one's lineage, descent, or progeny.

in_hindi.name: वंश
in_hindi.long_meaning: The same as Sanskrit, but the pronunciation is slightly different in Hindi.

in_tamil.name: வம்சம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil translation of Vamsha means 'growing or expanding clan' or 'prosperous lineage'.

in_telugu.name: వంశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu translation of Vamsha means 'one who has a vast lineage' or 'one who has many descendants'.

in_marathi.name: Vamsha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vamsha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A sacred branch that represents the continuity of a lineage or tradition. In Hindu mythology, Vamsha is the name of a celestial tree, the Ashvattha or the Peepal tree, under which the gods come to seek shelter and peace.

in_bengali.name: Vamsha
